entries.developer_comments: ~ Help message in menu 'Mind Over Matter: Using Psionic Powers'
identity: Powers have a chance to fail based on a number of factors.  The most important by far is your Metaphysics skill vs. the power's Difficulty, and the chance of failure is also reduced by your intelligence and, to a much lesser extent, the power's level.  It is increased by having a high Nether Attunement, by channeling several powers in short succession, and by having higher weariness levels (Moderate or above). Your chance of success is capped based on whether you have the concentration proficiencies or not; only with Concentration (Master) can you reach 100% chance to succeed.

identity: Disable and retrieve the unusual robot by <color_yellow>successfully stunning it with the prototype rifle provided,</color> then <color_yellow>quickly running up and deactivating the robot before it recovers from the stun</color>.  You can keep shooting it while it's stunned to prolong the time until it is active again.  You can intercept the robot indicated by Hub 01, or find an inactive robot somewhere else.  <color_yellow>You'll need to read the 'trifacet handling procedures' manual before trying to deactivate it</color>.
